_doc: A lifecycle.py plan for the layout-5 rehearsal in the scratch project (owner question D1). Copy it outside the repository, fill in the ids and paths, then `lifecycle.py check <leg> --plan` before a run. Commands are argv lists (no shell); {stage} {release} {url} {out} {home} {ledger} {ledgers} {seed} {duration} {windows} are filled per step; load.produce must write its window lines to {windows} (k2gen --out), which the d10-cell and rollback verdicts read. Files named *_file and under env_files hold secrets: mode 0600, never pasted.

cell.service_id: <the streams-cell service id, from the deploy report>

commands._doc: deploy/composer/deploy-release.sh and deploy/composer/cell-check are the deploy path's tools, at the paths and with the arguments triage B5 specifies; neither exists in this tree yet. A same-release Composer deploy is a no-op (triage D18), so `restart` must make a new version of the same release: B5 as specified has no such mode, and --restart is a PLACEHOLDER for the one it needs (for example a deploy-nonce envParam that forces a new deployment). Check every flag against B5 once it lands.

probe._doc: Leg 1. The probe deploys into its own stage of the scratch app; give service_id once known, or project_id to find the service named *sigtermprobe*.

oom._doc: Scratch only, NON-SHIPPING: deploy sets ADMIT_RSS_SHED_MB=2000 and ABSORB_GLOBAL_GATHERS=4 for this stage (CHAOS-5's recipe); restore redeploys the shipping release.

feeds._doc: Each publish command edits the bundle with cell-admin and uploads it to the cell's FEEDS_S3_KEY; admit_headers_file is the admitted-then-revoked project's token, steady_headers_file a project that stays admitted.

boot_failures._doc: Each case's deploy is any command that deploys that broken cell (a release without one secret, a release dir holding an aarch64 binary); expect_log is a regex the refusal's log line matches; restore redeploys the good release. deploy-release.sh's preflight refuses a missing secret (triage B5), so --without-secret is a PLACEHOLDER for the way past it B5 must provide.
